01 / LIFE INSIDE

What happens inside.

✧

They live.

Beings with their own needs, habits and memories, shaped by what happens to them.

◇

They build.

Weather, seasons and scarce materials. Shelter, paths and villages emerge on their own.

✦

They grow.

Bodies change, skills develop, and every world writes its own history.

02 / SAME RULES. DIFFERENT STORIES.

Ultra Worlds.

03 / WHY IT’S DIFFERENT

A world with
consequences.

Most AI worlds are chatbots in costumes. Ultra Worlds are physical: beings have bodies, the world has weather and consequences, and behaviour comes from experience, not from a script.
